en.t: The Visigoths, led by king Alaric I, cross the Alps and invade northern Italy
en.s: Alaric I (; Gothic: 𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃, Alarīks lit.'ruler of all'; Latin: Alaricus; c. 370 – 411 AD) was the first king of the Visigoths, from 395 to 410. He rose to leadership of the Goths who came to occupy Moesia—territory acquired a couple of decades earlier by a combined force of Goths and Alans after the Battle of Adrianople.

zh.t: 阿拉里克一世率领西哥特人翻越阿尔卑斯山，入侵意大利北部
zh.s: 阿拉里克一世（哥特语：𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃，Alarīks，意为“众人之王”；拉丁语：Alaricus；约370—411年）是西哥特人的首位国王，统治时间为395年至410年。他成为哥特人的领袖，率众占据默西亚；数十年前，哥特人和阿兰人联军在阿德里安堡战役后取得了这片领土。

en.t: The Council of Clermont begins: called by Pope Urban II, it led to the First Crusade to the Holy Land
en.s: The Council of Clermont was a mixed synod of ecclesiastics and laymen of the Catholic Church, called by Pope Urban II and held from 17 to 27 November 1095 at Clermont, Auvergne, at the time part of the Duchy of Aquitaine. While the council is known today primarily for the speech Pope Urban gave on the final day, it was primarily a synod focused on implementing the Cluniac reforms, enacting decrees and settling local and regional issues.

zh.t: 克莱蒙会议召开：教皇乌尔班二世召集会议，促成第一次十字军东征圣地
zh.s: 克莱蒙会议是天主教会的一次教士与世俗人士共同参加的会议，由教皇乌尔班二世召集，于1095年11月17日至27日在奥弗涅的克莱蒙举行。当时克莱蒙属于阿基坦公国。如今人们主要因乌尔班教皇在会议最后一天发表的演说而记得这次会议，但会议的主要议题是推行克吕尼改革、颁布法令，以及处理地方和区域事务。

en.s: The St. Elizabeth's flood of 1421 was a flooding of the Grote Hollandse Waard, an area in what is now the Netherlands. It takes its name from the feast day of Saint Elisabeth of Hungary which was formerly 19 November. During the night of 18–19 November 1421 a heavy storm near the North Sea coast caused the dikes to break in a number of places and the lower-lying polder land was flooded.

zh.s: 1421年圣伊丽莎白洪灾淹没了当时位于荷兰的大片区域Grote Hollandse Waard。洪灾以匈牙利圣伊丽莎白的瞻礼日命名；该瞻礼日过去定在11月19日。1421年11月18日至19日夜间，北海沿岸附近遭遇强风暴，多处堤坝决口，地势较低的圩田被洪水淹没。

en.s: The Battle of Verbia was the decisive episode in Iacob Heraclid (Despot)'s invasion of Moldavia, taking place on November 18 (Old Style: November 8), 1561. Heraclid and Olbracht Łaski's army was backed by the Holy Roman Empire and possibly also by the Knights Hospitaller; it comprised foreign mercenaries, including Spaniards armed with arquebuses, making this the first battle in Moldavian history to be won by superior firepower.

zh.s: 韦尔比亚战役是雅各布·赫拉克利德（暴君）入侵摩尔达维亚的决定性战役，发生于1561年11月18日（儒略历：11月8日）。赫拉克利德和奥尔布拉赫特·拉斯基的军队得到神圣罗马帝国支持，也可能得到医院骑士团支持。军中有外国雇佣兵，包括装备火绳枪的西班牙人。这是摩尔达维亚历史上首次凭借火力优势获胜的战斗。

en.s: During the siege of Nagykanizsa (Turkish: Kanije Savunması, lit. 'The Defence of Kanizsa') in 1601, a small Ottoman force held the fortress of Naģykanizsa in western Hungary against a much larger coalition army of the Habsburg monarchy, while inflicting heavy losses on its besiegers. This battle was part of the Long War between the Ottoman Empire and the House of Habsburg, lasting from 1593 to 1606.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1601年围攻纳吉卡尼饶时，一支规模较小的奥斯曼军队在匈牙利西部守住纳吉卡尼饶要塞，抵挡规模大得多的哈布斯堡王朝联军，并给围城部队造成重大损失。这场战斗属于1593年至1606年奥斯曼帝国与哈布斯堡王朝之间的长期战争。

en.t: The new St. Peter's Basilica in Rome is consecrated
en.s: The Papal Basilica of Saint Peter in the Vatican (Italian: Basilica Papale di San Pietro in Vaticano), or simply St. Peter's Basilica (Latin: Basilica Sancti Petri; Italian: Basilica di San Pietro [baˈziːlika di sam ˈpjɛːtro]), is a church of the Italian Renaissance located in Vatican City, an independent microstate enclaved within the city of Rome, Italy.

zh.t: 罗马新圣彼得大教堂举行祝圣仪式
zh.s: 梵蒂冈圣伯多禄宗座圣殿，简称圣伯多禄大殿（拉丁语：Basilica Sancti Petri；意大利语：Basilica di San Pietro），是一座意大利文艺复兴时期教堂，位于梵蒂冈城国。梵蒂冈城国是被意大利罗马市区包围的独立微型国家。

en.s: The battle of Pungo Andongo (also known as the siege of Pungo Andongo or the battle of Mpungu-a-Ndongo), was a military engagement in what is today Angola between Portugal and the Kingdom of Ndongo (Andongo in Portuguese) whose capital, Pungo Andongo, also known as Pedras Negras, was besieged. After a 9-month long encirclement, the capital was taken by storm, plundered, and occupied by the Portuguese.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蓬古安东戈战役又称蓬古安东戈围城战或姆蓬古-恩东戈战役，是一场发生在今安哥拉境内的军事冲突。葡萄牙与恩东戈王国交战，葡军围困恩东戈王国首都蓬古安东戈（又称黑石城）。围城持续9个月后，葡萄牙人强攻攻占首都，将其洗劫并占领。
zh.n: 此条记录的是围城结束日期，来源信息框如此标注。

en.s: The Battle of Valkininkai (Lithuanian: Valkininkų mūšis, Polish: Bitwa pod Olkienikami) took place on November 18, 1700, during the Lithuanian Civil War, between forces of the Sapieha family, led by Michał Franciszek Sapieha, and an anti-Sapieha coalition of Wiśniowiecki, Ogiński, Radziwiłł and Pac families and their supporters (including a pospolite ruszenie of Lithuanian and Samogitian szlachta), led by Michał Serwacy Wiśniowiecki. The anti-Sapieha confederates were victorious.

zh.s: 1700年11月18日立陶宛内战期间，萨皮耶哈家族与反萨皮耶哈联盟在瓦尔基宁凯交战。萨皮耶哈家族由米哈乌·弗朗齐谢克·萨皮耶哈率领；反萨皮耶哈联盟由米哈乌·谢拉齐·维希尼奥维茨基率领，成员包括维希尼奥维茨基、奥金斯基、拉齐维乌和帕茨家族及其支持者，其中包括立陶宛和萨莫吉希亚贵族组成的民兵。反萨皮耶哈联盟获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Güstow was a battle during the Pomeranian War in the Seven Years' War fought between Prussia and Sweden near the village Güstow in Germany on 18 November 1758. The battle ended with a Prussian victory.

zh.s: 1758年11月18日，七年战争期间的波美拉尼亚战争中，普鲁士和瑞典在德国居斯托夫村附近交战。战斗以普鲁士获胜告终。

en.s: The Black Boys Rebellion, Smith's Rebellion or Allegheny Uprising, was an armed uprising in the Province of Pennsylvania between March 5 and November 18, 1765. The nine-month uprising began when a wagon train loaded with illegal "warlike goods" was discovered at Pawling's Tavern (south of Greencastle, Pennsylvania). Alarmed by the train's contents, citizens led by James Smith intercepted and destroyed the goods (valued at over $1 million in today's currency) at a mountain pass near Sideling Hill.

zh.s: 黑男孩起义又称史密斯起义或阿勒格尼起义，是宾夕法尼亚省于1765年3月5日至11月18日发生的一场武装起义，持续了9个月。起因是一列装载非法“军用物资”的马车在宾夕法尼亚州格林卡斯尔以南的波林酒馆被发现。詹姆斯·史密斯带领当地居民担忧车上物品的危险，在西德灵山附近一处山口拦截并销毁了这批价值超过100万美元（按今日币值计算）的货物。

en.s: The Raid on Charlottetown of 17–18 November 1775, early in the American Revolutionary War, involved two American privateers of the Marblehead Regiment attacking and pillaging Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, then known as St. John's Island. The raid motivated Nova Scotia Governor Francis Legge to declare martial law. Despite the raid's success, George Washington immediately freed senior colonial officials the privateers had brought back as prisoners to Cambridge, Massachusetts.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1775年11月17日至18日，美国独立战争初期，马布尔黑德团的两艘美国私掠船袭击并掠夺了当时名为圣约翰岛的爱德华王子岛夏洛特敦。此次袭击促使新斯科舍省总督弗朗西斯·莱格宣布戒严。尽管袭击得手，乔治·华盛顿仍立即释放了私掠船押送至马萨诸塞州剑桥的殖民地高级官员。
zh.n: 此条记录的是袭击结束日期，来源信息框如此标注。

en.s: The Battle of Sangarará was fought on November 18, 1780 in Sangarará, Viceroyalty of Peru, between rebel forces under Túpac Amaru II and Spanish colonial forces under Tiburcio Landa. Túpac Amaru II's forces decsively defeated the hastely formed Spanish militia sent from Cusco. The battle was the first of the rebellion, and was the largest rebel victory of the war.

zh.s: 1780年11月18日，图帕克·阿马鲁二世率领的叛军与蒂布尔西奥·兰达率领的西班牙殖民军在秘鲁总督辖区的桑加拉拉交战。图帕克·阿马鲁二世的部队决定性地击败了从库斯科派出的仓促组建的西班牙民兵。这是起义爆发后的首场战斗，也是叛军在这场战争中取得的最大胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Tellicherry was a naval action fought off the Indian port of Tellicherry between British and French warships on 18 November 1791 during the Third Anglo-Mysore War. Britain and France were not at war at the time of the engagement, but French support for the Kingdom of Mysore in the conflict with the British East India Company had led to Royal Navy patrols stopping and searching French ships sailing for the Mysorean port of Mangalore. When a French convoy from Mahé passed the British port of Tellicherry in November 1791, Commodore William Cornwallis sent a small squadron to intercept the French ships.

zh.s: 1791年11月18日，第三次英迈索尔战争期间，英国和法国军舰在印度港口特利切里外海交战。英法当时并未处于战争状态，但法国支持迈索尔王国与英国东印度公司的冲突，促使英国皇家海军巡逻队拦截并搜查驶往迈索尔港口门格洛尔的法国船只。1791年11月，一支法国船队从马埃驶过英国港口特利切里时，威廉·康沃利斯准将派出一支小舰队拦截。

en.s: The 1799 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 18, 1799, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Incumbent Federalist Governor Benjamin Ogle was easily re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1799年马里兰州州长选举于11月18日举行，以选出马里兰州州长。时任联邦党州长本杰明·奥格尔因没有对手，由马里兰州议会轻松连任。此次选举的具体结果不详。

en.s: The Battle of Vertières (in Haitian Creole Batay Vètyè) was the last major battle of the Second War of Haitian Independence, and the final part of the Haitian Revolution under Jean Jacques Dessalines. It was fought between Haitian slave populations and Napoleon's French expeditionary forces on 18 November 1803 to Saint Domingue to restore slavery for France. Vertières is situated just south of Cap-Haïtien (known then as Cap-Français), in the Départment du Nord, Haiti. By the end of October 1803, Haitian rebels slaves had already taken over all the territory from France. The only places left to France were Mole St.

zh.s: 维蒂耶尔战役是海地第二次独立战争的最后一场重要战斗，也是让-雅克·德萨林领导的海地革命最后阶段。1803年11月18日，海地被奴役人口与拿破仑派往圣多明各、意图为法国恢复奴隶制的远征军交战。维蒂耶尔位于海地海地角（当时称法兰西角）以南，属于北省。1803年10月底，海地起义者已控制法国在当地的全部领土，法国仅剩莫勒圣尼古拉等地。

en.s: The action of 18 November 1809 was the major engagement of a six-month cruise in the Indian Ocean by a French navy squadron during the Napoleonic Wars. Under Commodore Jacques Félix Emmanuel Hamelin, the squadron engaged in commerce raiding across the Bay of Bengal. Hamelin's squadron achieved local superiority, capturing several British merchant ships and destroying a factory of the East India Company (EIC).

zh.s: 1809年11月18日的海战是拿破仑战争期间法国海军一支舰队在印度洋进行的为期六个月巡航中的主要交战。雅克·费利克斯·埃马纽埃尔·阿姆兰准将率领舰队在孟加拉湾袭击商船。阿姆兰的舰队一度取得局部优势，俘获数艘英国商船，并摧毁了东印度公司的一处商站。

en.s: The Battle of Krasnoi (at Krasny or Krasnoe) unfolded from 15 to 18 November 1812 marking a critical episode in Napoleon's arduous retreat from Moscow. Over the course of six skirmishes the Russian forces under Field Marshal Kutuzov inflicted significant blows from a prepared ambush upon the remnants of the Grande Armée, already severely weakened by attrition warfare.
en.n: Napoleonic Wars: The Battle of Krasnoi ends in French defeat, but Marshal of France Michel Ney's leadership leads to him becoming known as "the bravest of the brave".

zh.s: 克拉斯诺伊战役又称克拉斯内或克拉斯诺耶战役，于1812年11月15日至18日发生，是拿破仑从莫斯科艰难撤退过程中的关键战役。俄军在库图佐夫元帅指挥下发动伏击，经过六次交战，重创了已因消耗战而大幅削弱的法军大军团残部。
zh.n: 克拉斯诺伊战役以法国战败告终，但法国元帅米歇尔·内伊的表现使他被誉为“勇中之勇”。

en.s: The Battle of Ingavi occurred on November 18, 1841, in the town of Ingavi, Bolivia. There the Bolivian Army commanded by Jose Ballivian met an invading Peruvian Army commanded by Agustín Gamarra who would later die during the battle.

zh.s: 1841年11月18日，因加维战役在玻利维亚因加维镇发生。何塞·巴利维安指挥的玻利维亚军队与阿古斯丁·加马拉指挥的秘鲁入侵军交战，加马拉在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The 1852 Newfoundland general election was held on November 18, 1852 to elect members of the 5th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Newfoundland Colony. The Liberal Party maintained control of the House of Assembly. This was the last election to be held in Newfoundland prior to the introduction of responsible government in 1855.

zh.s: 纽芬兰殖民地于1852年11月18日举行大选，选出纽芬兰第五届议会的议员。自由党继续控制众议院。这是1855年引入责任政府前纽芬兰举行的最后一次选举。

en.s: The Town of Christchurch by-election, 1856 was a by-election held in the Town of Christchurch electorate during the 2nd New Zealand Parliament, on 18 November 1856. The by-election was caused by the resignation of incumbent MP Henry Sewell and was won by Richard Packer. Packer had been invited to stand for election in the 1855 election, but he had declined the requisition because of the popularity of Sewell, the incumbent. Sewell resigned on 16 August 1856, the final day of the first session of the 2nd New Zealand Parliament. This was in preparation of his departure for England.

zh.s: 1856年基督城选区补选于11月18日在新西兰第二届议会期间举行。时任议员亨利·休厄尔辞职后触发补选，理查德·帕克胜出。帕克曾在1855年获邀参选，但因休厄尔当时颇受欢迎而拒绝参选。休厄尔于1856年8月16日辞职，那天是新西兰第二届议会第一次会议的最后一天；他辞职是为赴英做准备。

en.s: The Battle of Sanhe (Chinese: 三河之戰, literally "Battle of Three Rivers") was a major engagement of the Taiping Rebellion, occurring in 1858. During this battle, the elite troops of Zeng Guofan's Xiang Army were lost, along with one of its most capable commanders, Li Xubin as well as Zeng Guofan's brother Zeng Guohua.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 三河之战（中文名：三河之战）是太平天国运动中的一场重要战役，发生于1858年。曾国藩湘军的精锐部队在战斗中覆灭，其最能干的将领之一李续宾以及曾国藩的弟弟曾国华也在战斗中阵亡。
zh.n: 此条记录的是战役结束日期，来源信息框如此标注。

en.s: The Battle of Kabletown took place between Confederate and Union forces near the end of the American Civil War. Captain John S. Mosby, with nine companies of cavalry, defeated Captain Richard R. Blazer's outnumbered Blazer's Scouts.

zh.s: 美国内战后期，邦联军与联邦军在卡布尔敦附近交战。约翰·S·莫斯比上尉率领9个骑兵连，击败了兵力较少的理查德·R·布莱泽上尉及其侦察队。

en.t: An earthquake strikes the Virgin Islands, triggering the largest tsunami witnessed in the Caribbean and killing dozens
en.s: The Virgin Islands (Spanish: Islas Vírgenes) is an archipelago between the North Atlantic Ocean and northeastern Caribbean Sea, located to the immediate east of the main island of Puerto Rico. It generally forms part of the Leeward Islands of the Lesser Antilles in the West Indies of the Caribbean region.

zh.t: 维尔京群岛发生地震，引发加勒比地区有记录以来最大海啸，造成数十人死亡
zh.s: 维尔京群岛（西班牙语：Islas Vírgenes）是位于北大西洋与加勒比海东北部之间的群岛，紧邻波多黎各主岛以东。它通常被视为西印度群岛小安的列斯群岛背风群岛的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Chateauneuf-en-Thimerais was a battle of the Franco-Prussian War, which took place on November 18, 1870, in the commune of Châteauneuf-en-Thymerais in France. This was one of a series of victories by a division of the Prussian army along the Loire under the command of Frederick Francis II, Grand Duke of Mecklenburg-Schwerin before the Garde Mobile's forces fledgling by commander Minister Fiereck, within a week after the Imperial German Army was defeated at the Battle of Coulmiers.

zh.s: 1870年11月18日，普法战争中的沙托讷夫昂蒂姆赖战役在法国爆发。弗里德里希·弗朗茨二世率领的普鲁士军队取得胜利；这也是该部队沿卢瓦尔河一带连续取得的几场胜利之一。

en.t: American suffragist Susan B. Anthony (pictured) was arrested and later fined $100 for having voted in the presidential election two weeks earlier
en.s: Susan B. Anthony (born Susan Anthony; February 15, 1820 – March 13, 1906) was an American social reformer and women's rights activist who played a pivotal role in the women's suffrage movement. Born into a Quaker family committed to social equality, she collected anti-slavery petitions at the age of 17. In 1856, she became the New York state agent for the American Anti-Slavery Society.

zh.t: 美国女性参政权活动家苏珊·B·安东尼因在两周前的总统选举中投票而被捕，后被罚款100美元
zh.s: 苏珊·B·安东尼（原名苏珊·安东尼；1820年2月15日—1906年3月13日）是美国社会改革家和女性权利活动家，在女性参政权运动中发挥了关键作用。她出生于支持社会平等的贵格会家庭，17岁时就开始收集反奴隶制请愿书。1856年，她成为美国反奴隶制协会纽约州代理人。

en.s: The Capture of the corvette Pilcomayo was a battle of the Naval campaign of the War of the Pacific. In the battle, the Peruvian gunboat Pilcomayo was captured by the Chilean ironclad Blanco Encalada after a brief confrontation.

zh.s: 皮尔科马约号被俘事件是太平洋战争海战行动中的一场战斗。交战中，秘鲁炮舰皮尔科马约号在短暂交火后被智利铁甲舰布兰科·恩卡拉达号俘获。

en.t: Elisha P. Ferry is inaugurated as first governor of Washington
en.s: Elisha Peyre Ferry (August 9, 1825 – October 14, 1895) was an American lawyer and politician who served as the first governor of Washington from 1889 to 1893. Ferry was a Republican who had twice been Governor of Washington Territory, the only one to serve two terms. On Washington's admission as a state on November 11, 1889, he became its inaugural governor, serving one term, stepping down in 1893 because of failing health.

zh.t: 埃利沙·P·费里就任华盛顿州首任州长
zh.s: 埃利沙·佩雷·费里（1825年8月9日—1895年10月14日）是美国律师和政治家，1889年至1893年担任华盛顿州首任州长。费里是共和党人，曾两度担任华盛顿领地州长，也是唯一一位连任两届的领地州长。华盛顿州于1889年11月11日加入联邦后，他就任首任州长，任职一届，因健康恶化于1893年离任。

en.t: Battle of Paso de las Damas
en.s: The Battle of Paso de las Damas was a battle of the Cuban War of Independence that took place on 18 November 1896 at the Santa Clara Province.

zh.t: 帕索德拉斯达马斯战役
zh.s: 帕索德拉斯达马斯战役是古巴独立战争中的一场战斗，于1896年11月18日在圣克拉拉省发生。

en.s: The Hay–Pauncefote Treaty is a treaty signed by the United States and the United Kingdom on 18 November 1901, as a preliminary to the creation of the Panama Canal. The Treaty nullified the Clayton–Bulwer Treaty of 1850 and gave the United States the right to create and control a canal across the Central American isthmus to connect the Pacific Ocean and the Atlantic Ocean. In the Clayton–Bulwer Treaty, both nations had renounced building such a canal under the sole control of one nation.

zh.s: 美国和英国于1901年11月18日签署《海伊—庞斯福特条约》，为修建巴拿马运河做准备。该条约废除了1850年的《克莱顿—布尔沃条约》，并允许美国修建和控制一条穿过中美洲地峡、连接太平洋和大西洋的运河。根据《克莱顿—布尔沃条约》，两国此前都放弃了由单一国家独自控制运河的做法。

en.s: The Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty (Spanish: Tratado Hay-Bunau Varilla) was a treaty signed on November 18, 1903, by the United States and Panama, which established the Panama Canal Zone and the subsequent construction of the Panama Canal. It was named after its two primary negotiators, Philippe-Jean Bunau-Varilla, the French diplomatic representative of Panama, and United States secretary of state John Hay.

zh.s: 美国和巴拿马于1903年11月18日签署《海伊—布诺-瓦里拉条约》（西班牙语：Tratado Hay-Bunau Varilla），设立巴拿马运河区，为随后修建巴拿马运河奠定基础。条约以两名主要谈判代表的名字命名：代表巴拿马的法国外交官菲利普-让·布诺-瓦里拉，以及美国国务卿约翰·海伊。

en.s: The 1908 Prince Edward Island general election was held in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island on November 18, 1908. The election was won by the governing Liberals, led by incumbent Premier Francis Haszard. Haszard had taken over from his predecessor, Arthur Peters, following his death in January 1908. Haszard resigned as Premier in 1911 following appointment to the province's Supreme Court, and he was succeeded as Premier by H.

zh.s: 加拿大爱德华王子岛省于1908年11月18日举行大选。由时任省长弗朗西斯·哈扎德领导的执政自由党获胜。哈扎德于1908年1月前任省长阿瑟·彼得斯去世后接任。1911年，哈扎德获任该省最高法院法官后辞去省长职务，由H。接任。

en.s: The Battle of Krzywoploty took place on November 17 – 18, 1914, near the village of Krzywoploty, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland, and was located near the border with Austrian Galicia. Two battalions (440 soldiers) of 1st Regiment of Polish Legions in World War I (part of Austro-Hungarian Army) clashed with the Imperial Russian Army, in an attempt to stop a Russian offensive.

en.s: The Battle of the Somme (French: Bataille de la Somme, German: Schlacht an der Somme), also known as the Somme Offensive, was a battle of the First World War fought by the armies of the British and French empires against the German Empire. It took place between 1 July and 18 November 1916 on both sides of the upper reaches of the River Somme in France. The battle was intended to hasten a victory for the Allies and was the largest battle of the First World War on the Western Front.

zh.s: 索姆河战役又称索姆河攻势，是第一次世界大战期间英国和法国帝国军队与德意志帝国军队交战的一场战役，发生于1916年7月1日至11月18日，战场位于法国索姆河上游两岸。盟军希望借此加快战争胜利。这是第一次世界大战西线规模最大的一场战役。

en.s: The Battle of the Ancre (13–18 November 1916), was fought by the British Fifth Army (Lieutenant-General Hubert Gough), against the German 1st Army (General Fritz von Below). The Reserve Army had been renamed the Fifth Army on 30 October. The battle was the last of the big British attacks of the Battle of the Somme.

en.s: The Capture of Beaumont-Hamel was a tactical incident that took place during the Battle of the Somme (1 July – 18 November 1916) in the Battle of the Ancre (13–18 November) during the second British attempt to take the village. Beaumont-Hamel is a commune in the Somme department of Picardy in northern France. The village had been attacked on 1 July, the First Day of the Somme.

en.s: The Battle of Motovylivka was a military engagement fought between forces of the Ukrainian State and the Directorate of Ukraine. The battle took place on 18 November 1918 during the Ukrainian Civil War, and resulted in a major victory for the Directorate. The battle resulted in the eventual collapse of the Ukrainian State in December 1918.

zh.s: 1918年11月18日，乌克兰内战期间，乌克兰国与乌克兰督政府的军队在莫托维利夫卡交战。督政府获胜，这场胜利最终促成乌克兰国于1918年12月垮台。

en.s: The Kolchak Coup or Omsk Coup refers to the events of 18 November 1918, when members associated with the left wing of the Directory (Provisional All-Russian Government) were arrested by members of the White Army in Omsk and the subsequent decision of the All-Russian Council of Ministers to transfer sole supreme power to Alexander Kolchak, the Minister of Military and Naval Affairs.

zh.s: 1918年11月18日，鄂木斯克发生高尔察克政变。与临时全俄政府领导机构有关的左翼成员被白军逮捕，随后全俄部长会议决定将最高权力交给陆海军部长亚历山大·高尔察克。

en.t: After centuries of Teutonic, Swedish, Polish-Lithuanian, and Russian rule, the independent Republic of Latvia was established on 18 November 1918 after breaking away from the Russian Empire in the aftermath of World War I
en.s: Latvia, officially the Republic of Latvia, is a country in the Baltic region of northern Europe. It is one of the three Baltic states, along with Estonia to the north and Lithuania to the south. It borders Russia to the east and Belarus to the southeast and shares a maritime border with Sweden to the west. Latvia covers an area of 64,573 km2 (24,932 sq mi), with a population of 1.83 million.

zh.t: 拉脱维亚独立共和国成立
zh.s: 经历数百年条顿骑士团、瑞典、波兰立陶宛联邦和俄罗斯统治后，拉脱维亚于第一次世界大战后脱离俄罗斯帝国，并于1918年11月18日建立独立共和国。拉脱维亚正式名称为拉脱维亚共和国，位于北欧波罗的海地区，是波罗的海三国之一，北邻爱沙尼亚，南接立陶宛。东邻俄罗斯，东南接白俄罗斯，西隔海与瑞典相望。国土面积64,573平方公里（24,932平方英里），人口183万。

en.s: The Advance on Moscow was a military campaign of the White Armed Forces of South Russia (AFSR), launched against the RSFSR in July 1919 during the Russian Civil War. The goal of the campaign was the capture of Moscow, which, according to the chief of the White Army Anton Denikin, would play a decisive role in the outcome of the Civil War and bring the Whites closer to the final victory.

en.s: The 1929 Grand Banks earthquake (also called the Laurentian Slope earthquake and the South Shore Disaster) occurred on November 18, 1929. The shock had a moment magnitude of 7.2 and a maximum Rossi–Forel intensity of VI (Strong tremor) and was centered in the Atlantic Ocean off the south coast of Newfoundland in the Laurentian Slope seismic zone.

en.s: The 1931 Calgary municipal election was held on November 18, 1931 to elect a Mayor and six Aldermen to sit on Calgary City Council. Along with positions on Calgary City Council, four trustees for the Public School Board, three trustees for the Separate School Board, and three questions put before the voters. Calgary City Council was composed of a Mayor, a Commissioner and twelve Aldermen who were elected to staggered two year terms.

zh.s: 1931年卡尔加里市政选举于11月18日举行，选出市长和6名市议员。选民还选出公立学校董事会的4名董事、独立学校董事会的3名董事，并对3项议案投票。卡尔加里市议会由市长、专员和12名议员组成，议员任期交错，每届两年。

en.s: Operation White (15–18 November 1940) was a British attempt to deliver fourteen aircraft, twelve Hurricane Mk II fighters and two Skua fighter–dive bombers, to Malta from the aircraft carrier HMS Argus. White was one of what became known as Club Runs, that supplied fighters for the defence of Malta.

en.s: Operation Flipper (also called the Rommel Raid) was a British commando raid, during the Second World War, carried out mainly by men from No. 11 (Scottish) Commando. The operation included among its objectives an attack on the headquarters of Erwin Rommel, the commander of the Afrika Korps in North Africa. It was timed to strike on the night of 17/18 November 1941, just before the start of Operation Crusader, a British offensive. The operation was a failure, Rommel had left the target house weeks earlier and all but two of the commandos who got ashore were killed or captured.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，英国突击队实施了弗利珀行动，又称“隆美尔突袭”，主要参与者来自第11（苏格兰）突击队。行动目标之一是袭击北非非洲军团指挥官埃尔温·隆美尔的总部。行动安排在1941年11月17日至18日夜间、英国十字军行动开始前进行，但最终失败：隆美尔几周前已离开目标住所，登陆的突击队员中除两人外，其余都被杀或被俘。

en.s: Convoy ON 144 was a trade convoy of merchant ships during the Second World War. It was the 144th of the numbered series of ON convoys Outbound from the British Isles to North America. The ships departed Liverpool on 7 November 1942 and were joined on 8 November by Mid-Ocean Escort Force Group B-6 consisting of the Flower-class corvettes Vervain, Potentilla, Eglantine, Montbretia and Rose and the convoy rescue ship Perth.

en.t: The Popular Socialist Youth is founded in Cuba
en.s: The Popular Socialist Youth (Spanish: Juventud Socialista Popular) was a youth organization in Cuba, the youth wing of the Popular Socialist Party. en.s: On 18 November 1947, a fire engulfed Ballantynes department store in central Christchurch, New Zealand. 41 people died in the blaze; all were employees who found themselves trapped by the fire or were overcome by smoke while evacuating the store complex without a fire alarm or evacuation plan. It remains the deadliest fire in New Zealand history.

The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method.

en.s: The 1956 Bulgarian Cup final was the 16th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between Levski Sofia and Botev Plovdiv on 18 November 1956 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. Levski won the final 5–2.

zh.s: 1956年保加利亚杯决赛是第16届保加利亚杯决赛，当时赛事名为苏军杯。索菲亚列夫斯基队和普罗夫迪夫博特夫队于1956年11月18日在索菲亚的瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场争夺冠军，列夫斯基队以5比2获胜。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Austria on 18 November 1962.The result was a victory for the Austrian People's Party, which won 81 of the 165 seats. Voter turnout was 93.8%. Although the People's Party had come up only two seats short of an outright majority, Chancellor Alfons Gorbach (who had succeeded Julius Raab a year earlier) retained the grand coalition with the Socialists under Vice-Chancellor Bruno Pittermann.

zh.s: 奥地利于1962年11月18日举行议会选举。奥地利人民党获胜，赢得165个席位中的81席，投票率为93.8%。人民党虽只差两席便能单独过半，仍由总理阿尔丰斯·戈尔巴赫（他一年前接替尤利乌斯·拉布）与布鲁诺·皮特曼副总理领导的社会党继续组成大联合政府。

en.s: The Battle of Rezang La , also known as Battle of No.8 and No.9 Indian Posts in Ngari (Chinese: 阿印8、9号据点之战) in Chinese narrative, was a military engagement that took place on 18 November 1962, during the Second phase of Sino-Indian War in wester LAC. To Chinese, it was a major military engagement in the Battle of Bangongluo (Chinese: 班公洛之战), where the reinforced 3rd Battalion of 11th Infantry Regiment was able to capture Rezang La with superior artillery fire in less than 2 hours.

zh.s: 热让拉战役又称“阿里第8、9号据点之战”。按中国方面的叙述，这场交战发生于1962年11月18日，是中印战争第二阶段在西部实际控制线上的一次军事交战。在班公洛之战中，增援的第11步兵团第3营凭借优势炮火，在不到两小时内攻占热让拉。

en.s: The November 1963 Iraqi coup d'état took place between November 13 and November 18, 1963, when, following internal party divisions, pro-Nasserist Iraqi officers led a military coup within the Ba'ath Party. Although the coup itself was bloodless, 250 people were killed in related actions. The government subsequently lasted until the 17 July Revolution in 1968.

zh.s: 1963年11月13日至18日，伊拉克复兴党内部出现分裂，亲纳赛尔派军官在党内发动军事政变。政变本身没有流血，但相关行动造成250人死亡。政变后的政府一直执政至1968年7月17日革命。

en.t: The Bell Telephone Company introduces the first push-button telephone
en.s: The Bell Telephone Company was an American telecommunications company active from 1877 to 1899. It was the initial corporate entity from which the Bell System originated to build a continental conglomerate and monopoly in telecommunication services in the United States and Canada. The company was organized in Boston, Massachusetts, on July 9, 1877, by Alexander Graham Bell's father-in-law Gardiner Greene Hubbard.

zh.t: 贝尔电话公司推出首款按键式电话
zh.s: 贝尔电话公司是1877年至1899年间经营的美国电信公司。它是贝尔系统最初的企业实体，后来形成了横跨美国和加拿大的电信服务集团及垄断体系。公司于1877年7月9日在马萨诸塞州波士顿成立，由亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔的岳父加德纳·格林·哈伯德创办。

en.t: 1972 Scotland v England women's football match
en.s: Scotland Women v England Women (1972) was the first ever official international women's football match to be played in Great Britain. It was contested by the national teams of Scotland and England. The match took place on 18 November 1972 at Ravenscraig Stadium in Greenock, Scotland. England won the game 3–2, almost exactly a hundred years after the first men's international between the two nations.

zh.t: 1972年苏格兰女足对英格兰女足比赛
zh.s: 1972年苏格兰女足对英格兰女足的比赛，是英国举行的首场正式女子足球国际赛。苏格兰和英格兰国家队于1972年11月18日在苏格兰格里诺克的雷文斯克雷格球场交手，英格兰以3比2获胜。比赛日期距两国首次男子国际赛恰好近100年。

en.s: The 1974 New Brunswick general election was held on November 18, 1974, to elect 58 members to the 48th New Brunswick Legislative Assembly, the governing house of the province of New Brunswick, Canada. It saw Richard Hatfield's Progressive Conservative Party of New Brunswick win its second majority government with a gain of one seat despite losing the popular vote to Robert J. Higgins's New Brunswick Liberal Party.

zh.s: 新不伦瑞克省于1974年11月18日举行大选，选出该省立法议会（第48届议会）的58名议员。理查德·哈特菲尔德领导的新不伦瑞克进步保守党增加一个席位，赢得第二个多数政府，尽管其得票总数低于罗伯特·J·希金斯领导的新不伦瑞克自由党。

en.s: Elections to the Nagaland Legislative Assembly were held in November 1977 to elect members of the 60 constituencies in Nagaland, India. United Democratic Front won the majority of seats and Vizol Koso was appointed as the Chief Minister of Nagaland for his second term. The number of constituencies was set as 60 by the recommendation of the Delimitation Commission of India.

zh.s: 那加兰邦于1977年11月举行立法议会选举，选出该邦60个选区的议员。联合民主阵线赢得多数席位，维佐尔·科索获任那加兰邦首席部长，这是他第二次担任该职。根据印度选区划界委员会的建议，选区数定为60个。

en.t: The McDonnell Douglas F/A-18 Hornet makes its first flight, at the Naval Air Test Center in Maryland, United States
en.s: The McDonnell Douglas F/A-18 Hornet is an all-weather supersonic, twin-engined, carrier-capable, multirole combat aircraft, designed as both a fighter and ground attack aircraft (hence the F/A designation). Designed by McDonnell Douglas and Northrop, the F/A-18 was derived from the YF-17 that lost against the YF-16 in the United States Air Force's lightweight fighter program.

zh.t: 麦克唐纳·道格拉斯F/A-18“大黄蜂”战斗机在美国马里兰州海军航空试验中心首飞
zh.s: 麦克唐纳·道格拉斯F/A-18“大黄蜂”是一款全天候、超音速、双发动机、可在航空母舰上起降的多用途战斗机，兼具战斗机和对地攻击机功能，因此采用F/A编号。该机由麦克唐纳·道格拉斯和诺斯罗普设计，源自YF-17；YF-17曾在美国空军轻型战斗机计划中败给YF-16。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 6833, en route from Tbilisi, Georgian SSR, to Leningrad, Russian SFSR, with an intermediate stop in Batumi, was the scene of an attempted aircraft hijacking by seven young Georgians on 18–19 November 1983. The crisis ended with a storming of the Tu-134A airliner by Alpha Group that resulted in eight dead. The surviving hijackers were subsequently tried and executed.

zh.t: 苏联民航6833号班机劫持未遂事件
zh.s: 苏联民航6833号班机从格鲁吉亚苏维埃社会主义共和国第比利斯飞往俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国列宁格勒，中途停靠巴统。1983年11月18日至19日，7名年轻的格鲁吉亚人试图劫持该机。危机以阿尔法小组突袭Tu-134A客机告终，造成8人死亡。幸存的劫机者后来受审并被处决。

en.t: The first comic of Calvin and Hobbes is published in ten newspapers
en.s: Calvin and Hobbes is an American daily comic strip created by cartoonist Bill Watterson and syndicated from November 18, 1985, to December 31, 1995. The strip centers on Calvin, a six-year-old boy characterized by his vivid imagination and rowdy behavior, and Hobbes, his stuffed tiger, who is a sentient being to Calvin but a regular toy to everyone else.

zh.s: 美国漫画家比尔·沃特森创作的日常连载漫画《加尔文与霍布斯》于1985年11月18日至1995年12月31日连载。漫画主角是想象力丰富、行为顽皮的6岁男孩加尔文，以及他的毛绒老虎霍布斯。对加尔文来说，霍布斯有生命；对其他人来说，它只是一只普通玩具。

en.s: The King's Cross fire occurred in 1987 at King's Cross St Pancras tube station in London, England, causing 31 fatalities. It began under a wooden escalator before spreading into the ticket hall in a flashover. The fire began at approximately 19:30 on 18 November 1987, at a major interchange on the London Underground.

zh.s: 1987年11月18日约19时30分，伦敦国王十字圣潘克拉斯地铁站发生火灾，造成31人死亡。火先在一部木制自动扶梯下方燃起，随后突然蔓延至售票大厅。该站是伦敦地铁的重要换乘站。

The Indian National Congress won the most seats and Hokishe Sema was appointed as the Chief Minister of Nagaland. en.t: Battles of Farsia and Oum Dreyga
en.s: The Battles of Farsia and Oum Dreyga occurred on 18 November 1987 in Farsia and Oum Dreyga, on the Moroccan side of the Moroccan Western Sahara Wall, when POLISARIO troops clashed with the Royal Moroccan Army. Over 300 combatants died as a result of the two battles. The clashes happened two days after the arrival of a United Nations technical mission whose goal was to evaluate the conditions for a self-determination referendum in Western Sahara.

zh.t: 法尔西亚和乌姆德雷加战役
zh.s: 1987年11月18日，波利萨里奥阵线部队与摩洛哥皇家军队在摩洛哥西撒哈拉墙一侧的法尔西亚和乌姆德雷加交战。两场战斗共造成300多名战斗人员死亡。交战发生在联合国技术代表团抵达两天后，该代表团的任务是评估西撒哈拉自决公投的条件。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held on November 18, 1990 to elect the Governor of Okinawa (沖縄県, Okinawa-ken), who is the southernmost and westernmost prefecture of Japan. The election was won by Masahide Ōta, who defeated incumbent Junji Nishime by approximately 30,000 votes. Ōta went on to serve as governor of the prefecture for 8 years.

zh.s: 冲绳县于1990年11月18日举行知事选举。冲绳县是日本最南端、最西端的都道府县。大田昌秀以约3万票的优势击败时任知事西铭顺治，当选知事，并任职8年。

en.s: The Battle of Vukovar (Croatian: Bitka za Vukovar, Serbian: Битка за Вуковар, Bitka za Vukovar) was an 87-day siege of Vukovar in eastern Croatia by the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA), supported by various paramilitary forces from Serbia, between August and November 1991. Before the Croatian War of Independence the Baroque town was a prosperous, mixed community of Croats, Serbs and other ethnic groups. As Yugoslavia began to break up, Serbia's President Slobodan Milošević and Croatia's President Franjo Tuđman began pursuing nationalist politics. In 1990, an armed insurrection was started by Croatian Serb militias, supported by the Serbian government and paramilitary groups, who seized control of Serb-populated areas of Croatia.

zh.s: 武科瓦尔战役是一次持续87天的围城战。1991年8月至11月，南斯拉夫人民军（JNA）在塞尔维亚多支准军事力量支持下，围攻克罗地亚东部的武科瓦尔。克罗地亚独立战争爆发前，这座巴洛克风格的小城经济繁荣，克罗地亚人、塞尔维亚人及其他族群杂居。南斯拉夫开始解体后，塞尔维亚总统斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇和克罗地亚总统弗拉尼奥·图季曼开始推行民族主义政策。1990年，在塞尔维亚政府及准军事组织支持下，克罗地亚塞族民兵发动武装叛乱，控制了克罗地亚境内塞族聚居地区。

en.t: The autonomous Croatian Community of Herzeg-Bosnia, which would in 1993 become a republic, was established in Bosnia and Herzegovina
en.s: The Croatian Republic of Herzeg-Bosnia (Croatian: Hrvatska Republika Herceg-Bosna) was an unrecognized geopolitical entity and quasi-state in Bosnia and Herzegovina. It was proclaimed on 18 November 1991 under the name Croatian Community of Herzeg-Bosnia (Croatian: Hrvatska Zajednica Herceg-Bosna) as a "political, cultural, economic and territorial whole" in the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina, and abolished on 14 August 1996.

zh.t: 赫尔采格-波斯尼亚克罗地亚共同体在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那成立
zh.s: 赫尔采格-波斯尼亚克罗地亚共和国是一个未获承认的地缘政治实体和准国家。它于1991年11月18日在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那境内宣布成立，名称为赫尔采格-波斯尼亚克罗地亚共同体，并自称为该国境内一个“政治、文化、经济和领土整体”。该实体于1996年8月14日废止。

en.s: The North American Free Trade Agreement (Spanish: Tratado de Libre Comercio de América del Norte, TLCAN; French: Accord de libre-échange nord-américain, ALÉNA), referred to colloquially in the Anglosphere as NAFTA ( NAF-tə), was an agreement signed by Canada, Mexico, and the United States that created a trilateral trade bloc in North America. The agreement came into force on January 1, 1994, and superseded the 1988 Canada–United States Free Trade Agreement between the United States and Canada.
en.n: In the United States, the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) is approved by the House of Representatives.

zh.s: 《北美自由贸易协定》（西班牙语：Tratado de Libre Comercio de América del Norte，TLCAN；法语：Accord de libre-échange nord-américain，ALÉNA；英语简称NAFTA）由加拿大、墨西哥和美国签署，建立了北美三边贸易集团。协定于1994年1月1日生效，取代1988年美国与加拿大签订的《加美自由贸易协定》。
zh.n: 美国众议院批准《北美自由贸易协定》（NAFTA）。

en.s: A leadership election for the Civic Democratic Party (ODS) was held in the Czech Republic on 18 November 1994 in Karlovy Vary. Václav Klaus was elected for another 1-year term. He received 266 votes of 275.

zh.s: 公民民主党（ODS）于1994年11月18日在捷克共和国卡罗维发利举行党魁选举。瓦茨拉夫·克劳斯再次当选，获得275票中的266票，任期一年。

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1995 was held on November 18, 1995 to elect the Governor of Louisiana. Incumbent Democratic Governor Edwin Edwards had planned to run for re-election to a second consecutive and fifth overall term in office, but he announced in June 1994, shortly after marrying his second wife Candy Picou, that he would be retiring from politics at the end of his term. All elections in Louisiana—with the exception of U.S. presidential elections—follow a variation of the open primary system called the jungle primary. Candidates of any and all parties are listed on one ballot; voters need not limit themselves to the candidates of one party when voting.

zh.s: 1995年路易斯安那州州长选举于11月18日举行，以选出州长。时任民主党州长埃德温·爱德华兹原本打算竞选连任，争取连续第二个、总计第五个任期；但他在1994年6月、与第二任妻子坎迪·皮库结婚后不久宣布，任期结束后将退出政坛。路易斯安那州除美国总统选举外，其他选举都采用一种称为“不分党派初选”的开放式初选制度：各党候选人都列在同一张选票上，选民投票时不必限于某一个党派的候选人。

en.s: The 1995 Louisiana lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 18, 1995, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Louisiana. Incumbent Democratic member of the Louisiana Public Service Commission from the 2nd district Kathleen Blanco defeated incumbent Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives Suzanne Mayfield Krieger in the Runoff election.

zh.t: 1995年路易斯安那州副州长选举
zh.s: 1995年路易斯安那州副州长选举于11月18日举行，以选出副州长。民主党籍州公共服务委员会第二区现任委员凯瑟琳·布兰科在第二轮投票中击败共和党籍州众议院现任议员苏珊·梅菲尔德·克里格。

en.s: November to Remember (1995) was the third November to Remember professional wrestling event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). The event took place on November 18, 1995 in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States. The event marked the return of Sabu to ECW after a stint in World Championship Wrestling (WCW) and the ECW debut of The Blue Meanie.

zh.s: 1995年“铭记十一月”是极限冠军摔角（ECW）举办的第三届同名职业摔角赛事，于1995年11月18日在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的ECW竞技场举行。萨布在离开世界冠军摔角（WCW）一段时间后重返ECW，蓝色疯子也在本次赛事中首次亮相ECW。

en.s: General elections were held in Zambia on 18 November 1996 to elect a President and National Assembly. They were boycotted by the main opposition party, the United National Independence Party, together with five other allied parties, following changes to the constitution which they failed to have reversed following a court challenge. The changes required a presidential candidate to be born to two Zambian citizens by birth or descent, and National Assembly candidates to give up their chieftaincy. UNIP believed this was specifically aimed at their candidates, Kenneth Kaunda, whose parents were Malawian and had previously served several terms as president, and its vice president, a chief.

zh.s: 赞比亚于1996年11月18日举行大选，选出总统和国民议会议员。主要反对党联合国家独立党及其五个盟友抵制选举。它们此前曾通过诉讼试图推翻宪法修正案，但没有成功。修正案要求总统候选人父母双方均为赞比亚出生公民，并要求国民议会候选人放弃酋长身份。联合国家独立党认为，这些规定是针对其候选人肯尼斯·卡翁达及其副主席而设；卡翁达的父母来自马拉维，他曾多次担任总统，而该副主席是一位酋长。

en.s: The Channel Tunnel fire of 18 November 1996 occurred on a train carrying Heavy Goods Vehicles (HGVs) and their drivers through the Channel Tunnel from France to the United Kingdom. The fire was seen on the train as it entered the tunnel and, in line with the policy at the time, an attempt was made to drive to the UK where the fire would be dealt with.

zh.s: 1996年11月18日，英法海底隧道内一列运载重型货车及司机、从法国驶往英国的列车发生火灾。列车进入隧道时发现起火。按照当时的规定，列车试图继续驶往英国，再在那里处理火情。

en.s: The 1996 Prince Edward Island general election was held on November 18, 1996. It was the first election in the province's history to not use multi-member constituencies, and instead elect a single member in each of 27 districts. (Previously, since 1873 the province had been divided into 15 or 16 districts, each electing two members.)

zh.s: 爱德华王子岛省于1996年11月18日举行大选。这是该省历史上首次不再使用多议席选区，而是在27个选区各选出一名议员。此前自1873年以来，该省划分为15或16个选区，每个选区各选出两名议员。

en.s: The 2001 Survivor Series was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the 15th annual Survivor Series and took place on November 18, 2001, at the Greensboro Coliseum in Greensboro, North Carolina. The event centered on the Survivor Series match, a tag team elimination match that pits teams of multiple wrestlers against each other.

zh.s: 2001年幸存者系列赛是世界摔角联盟（WWF，现为WWE）举办的职业摔角付费收看赛事，也是第15届年度幸存者系列赛。赛事于2001年11月18日在北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒的格林斯伯勒体育馆举行。比赛以幸存者系列赛为核心，这是一种多名摔角手组成队伍互相淘汰对手的团体赛。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in South Ossetia in 2001. As no candidate received a majority of the vote in the first round on 18 November, a second round was held on 6 December, which was won by Eduard Kokoity, who defeated Stanislav Kochiev. Incumbent president Lyudvig Chibirov was eliminated in the first round mostly due to popular disdain in his economic policies.

zh.s: 南奥塞梯于2001年举行总统选举。首轮投票于11月18日举行，没有候选人获得多数票，因此12月6日举行第二轮投票。爱德华·科科伊季在第二轮击败斯坦尼斯拉夫·科奇耶夫。时任总统柳德维格·奇比罗夫在首轮即遭淘汰，主要原因是选民普遍不满他的经济政策。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Bulgaria on 11 November 2001, with a second round on 18 November. Voter turnout was 41.8% in the first round and 55.1% in the second.

en.t: Goodridge v. Department of Public Health
en.s: Goodridge v. Dept. of Public Health, 798 N.E.2d 941 (Mass. 2003), is a landmark Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court case in which the Court held that the Massachusetts Constitution requires the state to legally recognize same-sex marriage. The November 18, 2003, decision was the first by a U.S. state's highest court to find that same-sex couples had the right to marry.

zh.t: 古德里奇诉公共卫生部案
zh.s: 古德里奇诉公共卫生部案（798 N.E.2d 941，马萨诸塞州，2003年）是马萨诸塞州最高司法法院的一起重要案件。法院裁定，马萨诸塞州宪法要求州政府在法律上承认同性婚姻。2003年11月18日作出的判决，是美国各州最高法院中首个认定同性伴侣有权结婚的判决。

en.s: An alleged coup d'état attempt occurred in Madagascar on November 18, 2006, during the lead-up to the December 3 presidential election, when retired army General Andrianafidisoa, also known as Fidy (and a previous Director General of OMNIS), declared military rule. en.s: The 2007 Hong Kong District Council elections were held on 18 November 2007. Elections were held to all 18 districts of Hong Kong, returned 405 members from directly elected constituencies out of total 534 councils member. A total number of 886 candidates contesting in 364 seats, while 41 seats were uncontested. A total number of 1.4 million voters cast their ballots, consisting 38% of the electorate, significantly lower than the last elections in 2003. The pro-Beijing flagship party Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong (DAB) received the largest victory in its history, rebounding their loss from the 2003 with extra gain.

en.t: Union for a Popular Movement leadership election, 2012
en.s: The 2012 leadership election of the Union for a Popular Movement (UMP), a political party in France was held on 18 November 2012. It renewed the leadership structures of the UMP following Nicolas Sarkozy's defeat in the 2012 presidential election and the party's defeat in the subsequent legislative election. The disputed results led to the first open crisis in the UMP since its creation in 2002.

en.t: 2014 New Zealand Labour Party leadership election
en.s: The New Zealand Labour Party held an election for the position of leader of the party on 18 November 2014; Andrew Little won said election. The election followed the resignation of leader David Cunliffe on 27 September 2014 after an historic general election defeat a week earlier. David Parker and Annette King were installed as interim leader and deputy leader, respectively.

zh.s: 新西兰工党于2014年11月18日举行党魁选举，安德鲁·利特尔胜出。此前，工党领袖戴维·坎利夫在一次创纪录的全国大选失利后一周，于9月27日辞职。戴维·帕克和安妮特·金随后分别出任临时党魁和副党魁。

en.s: The 2017 New Orleans mayoral election was held on November 18, 2017. On October 14 all candidates competed on one ballot regardless of party registration (called the nonpartisan blanket primary or "Louisiana primary"). Incumbent Democratic Mayor Mitch Landrieu was term-limited and could not seek reelection. This was the first time since the 1977 that New Orleans elections were held in the fall as opposed to February and March.

zh.s: 2017年新奥尔良市长选举于11月18日举行。10月14日，所有候选人不分党派登记情况在同一张选票上竞争，这种方式称为不分党派综合初选，也称“路易斯安那初选”。时任民主党市长米奇·兰德里厄已达到任期限制，不能竞选连任。这是新奥尔良自1977年以来首次在秋季而非2月和3月举行选举。

en.t: November 2017 Party of Free Citizens leadership election
en.s: A leadership election for the Czech Party of Free Citizens was held on 18 November 2017, after the party's unsuccessful results in the legislative election and consequent resignation of the party's leadership. The election was expected to be a two-way contest between Tomáš Pajonk and Jiří Payne, but on 11 November 2017, former leader Petr Mach announced his candidacy.

en.s: The 2017 NXT TakeOver: WarGames was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's developmental brand, NXT. It was the 17th NXT TakeOver event and the inaugural NXT WarGames. It took place on Saturday, November 18, 2017, at the Toyota Center in Houston, Texas as part of that year's Survivor Series weekend and aired exclusively on the WWE Network.

en.s: The 2017 Anambra State gubernatorial election occurred in Nigeria on 18 November 2017, the APGA nominee Willie Obiano won re-election, defeating Tony Nwoye of the APC. Willie Obiano won APGA gubernatorial candidate after emerging the sole candidate. He picked Nkem Okeke as his running mate. Tony Nwoye was the APC candidate with Dozie Ikedife as his running mate. 37 candidates contested in the election.

zh.s: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州于2017年11月18日举行州长选举。全进步大会党（APGA）候选人威利·奥比亚诺赢得连任，击败全体进步大会党（APC）的托尼·恩沃耶。奥比亚诺在成为APGA唯一候选人后获提名，并选择恩凯姆·奥凯克作为竞选搭档；恩沃耶则与多齐·伊凯迪费搭档。共有37名候选人参选。

en.s: A by-election for the seat of Northcote in the Victorian Legislative Assembly was held on 18 November 2017. The by-election was triggered by the death of Labor Party MP Fiona Richardson on 23 August 2017. While the seat historically has firmly been in the Labor Party's hands since its inception in 1927, environmental issues, rising house prices and demographic trends have resulted in a stronger Greens vote at recent elections.

zh.s: 维多利亚州立法议会诺斯科特选区于2017年11月18日举行补选。此次补选因工党议员菲奥娜·理查森于2017年8月23日去世而举行。该选区自1927年设立以来一直是工党的稳固席位，但环境问题、房价上涨和人口结构变化使绿党近年得票上升。

en.s: The 2017 LFA Super Taça was the second staging of the LFA Super Taça. A cup played in a single game between the two best teams in the country. Participants are classified through two main competitions: Liga Futebol Amadora Primeira Divisão and Taça 12 de Novembro. The match of this edition of ST was played on November 18, 2017, at the Estádio Municipal Baucau in the city of Baucau, in East Timor.

zh.s: 2017年东帝汶超级杯是第2届东帝汶超级杯。超级杯由国内两支最佳球队进行一场比赛，参赛队通过业余足球甲级联赛和“11月12日杯”两项主要赛事产生。本届比赛于2017年11月18日在东帝汶包考市的包考市政体育场举行。

Republican State Treasurer John Kennedy resigned after he was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016. First Assistant Treasurer Ron Henson replaced Kennedy as treasurer, and served until the special election.

zh.s: 路易斯安那州于2017年10月14日举行财务主管特别选举；如有必要，第二轮投票将于11月18日举行。共和党籍州财务主管约翰·肯尼迪于2016年当选联邦参议员后辞职。首席助理财务主管罗恩·亨森接任，任职至特别选举举行。

en.s: The 2018 Dehradun Municipal Corporation election was a municipal election to the Dehradun Municipal Corporation which governs Dehradun City, the largest city in Uttarakhand. It took place on 18 November 2018. To the 100-ward body, 60 members from the Bharatiya Janata Party were elected, while 34 came from the Indian National Congress and remaining six being Independents.

zh.s: 2018年德拉敦市政公司选举是为管理北阿坎德邦最大城市德拉敦的市政公司举行的选举，投票于2018年11月18日进行。在这个由100个选区组成的机构中，印度人民党当选60名议员，印度国民大会党当选34名，另有6名独立人士当选。

en.s: A by-election was held in Essonne's 1st constituency on 18 November 2018, with a second round on 25 November as no candidate secured a majority of votes in the first round. The by-election was prompted by the resignation of Manuel Valls to run for the mayoralty of Barcelona in the 2019 municipal elections.

zh.s: 埃松省第一选区于2018年11月18日举行补选。由于首轮没有候选人获得多数票，第二轮于11月25日举行。此次补选因曼努埃尔·瓦尔斯辞职而举行，他辞职是为了参加2019年巴塞罗那市政选举、竞选市长。

en.s: The 2018 Survivor Series was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw, SmackDown, and 205 Live. It was the 32nd annual Survivor Series and took place on November 18, 2018, at the Staples Center in Los Angeles, California. It was the first Survivor Series since 2009 to feature three brands.

zh.s: 2018年幸存者系列赛是WWE举办的职业摔角付费收看及网络直播赛事，由该公司主阵容品牌Raw、SmackDown和205 Live的摔角手参加。这是第32届年度幸存者系列赛，于2018年11月18日在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的斯台普斯中心举行。这是该赛事自2009年以来首次有三个品牌参加。

en.s: The 2018 Uttarakhand Municipal general elections were held in the Indian state of Uttarakhand on 18 November 2018. The Uttarakhand State Election Commission announced the poll dates on 15 October 2018. The results were declared on 20 November 2018. The elections for the Roorkee Municipal Corporation, municipal councils of Bajpur and Srinagar and the nagar panchayats of Chaukhutia and Selakui were postponed.

zh.s: 印度北阿坎德邦于2018年11月18日举行市政机构大选。北阿坎德邦选举委员会于2018年10月15日公布投票日期，选举结果于11月20日公布。鲁尔基市政公司、巴杰布尔和斯利纳加尔市政委员会，以及乔库蒂亚和塞拉库伊纳加尔乡镇的选举延期举行。

en.s: The 29th Stockholm International Film Festival took place on 7–18 November 2018 in Stockholm, Sweden. Canadian drama film Firecrackers won the Bronze Horse, most prestigious award.

en.s: General elections were held in Montserrat on 18 November 2019 for the nine elected seats in the Legislative Assembly. The result was a victory for the opposition Movement for Change and Prosperity, which won five of the nine elected seats.

zh.s: 蒙特塞拉特于2019年11月18日举行大选，选出立法议会9个民选席位。反对党变革与繁荣运动获胜，赢得9个民选席位中的5席。

en.s: General elections were held in the Marshall Islands on 18 November 2019. Opponents of President Hilda Heine won a majority of seats.

zh.s: 马绍尔群岛于2019年11月18日举行大选。反对总统希尔达·海妮的阵营赢得了多数席位。

en.s: On November 18, 2019, Malian troops were ambushed by the Islamic State in the Greater Sahara during a patrol of Tabankort, in Ménaka Cercle, Mali.

zh.s: 2019年11月18日，马里军队在马里梅纳卡省塔班科特巡逻时遭大撒哈拉伊斯兰国伏击。

en.t: The Utah monolith, built sometime in 2016 is discovered by state biologists of the Utah Division of Wildlife Resources
en.s: The Utah monolith was a metal pillar that stood in a slot canyon in northern San Juan County, Utah, United States. The pillar was 9.5 ft (2.9 m) tall and made of metal sheets riveted into a triangular prism. It was unlawfully placed on public land between July and October 2016, where it stood unnoticed for over four years until its discovery and removal in late 2020.

zh.s: 犹他州独石柱是一根位于美国犹他州圣胡安县北部狭谷中的金属柱，高9.5英尺（2.9米），由金属板铆接成三角棱柱。它于2016年7月至10月间被非法放置在公有土地上，四年多无人发现，直到2020年末才被发现并移走。

en.s: General elections were held in Tonga on 18 November 2021. Following the death of Prime Minister ʻAkilisi Pōhiva in 2019, the governing Democratic Party of the Friendly Islands (PTOA) fragmented and went into opposition. Finance Minister Pōhiva Tuʻiʻonetoa subsequently left the PTOA and formed the Tonga People's Party (PAK). He ascended to premiership after garnering the support of fellow PTOA defectors, independents and some of the nobles' representatives.

zh.s: 汤加于2021年11月18日举行大选。首相阿基利西·波希瓦于2019年去世后，执政的友好群岛民主党（PTOA）分裂并成为反对党。财政部长波希瓦·图伊奥内托阿随后退出PTOA，成立汤加人民党（PAK）。他在PTOA倒戈者、独立议员和部分贵族代表支持下出任首相。

en.s: The 2021 Supercopa de Chile (known as the Supercopa Easy 2021 for sponsorship purposes) was the ninth edition of the Supercopa de Chile, championship organised by the Asociación Nacional de Fútbol Profesional (ANFP). The match was played by the 2020 Chilean Primera División champions Universidad Católica and the 2020 Primera B de Chile champions Ñublense on 18 November 2021 at Estadio Ester Roa in Concepción.

zh.s: 2021年智利超级杯因赞助也称“Easy超级杯2021”，是第9届智利超级杯，由智利职业足球全国协会（ANFP）主办。2020年智利甲级联赛冠军天主教大学队与2020年智利乙级联赛冠军纽布伦斯队于2021年11月18日在康塞普西翁的埃斯特·罗阿体育场交手。

en.s: The Islamist insurgency in Benin is an ongoing armed conflict in Benin being waged by al-Qaeda-affiliate Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) and to a lesser extent, the Islamic State's Sahel Province (ISSP) and Islamic State (IS)-aligned Lakurawa. The insurgency began in late 2021 with low-level attacks near the Nigerien and Burkinabe borders, but escalated in 2022 after the Beninese government launched heavy counterattacks.

zh.s: 贝宁伊斯兰叛乱是一场仍在持续的武装冲突，交战方是基地组织附属组织“伊斯兰与穆斯林支持阵线”（JNIM），以及势力较小的伊斯兰国萨赫勒省（ISSP）和与伊斯兰国结盟的拉库拉瓦组织。叛乱于2021年末开始，最初是尼日尔和布基纳法索边境附近的小规模袭击；2022年贝宁政府发动大规模反击后，冲突升级。

en.s: Over Drive was a professional wrestling event produced by Impact Wrestling. It took place on November 18, 2022, at Old Forester's Paristown Hall in Louisville, Kentucky, and aired on Impact Plus and YouTube. The event also featured wrestlers from partner promotions Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) and New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW). Ten matches were contested at the event, including two on the Countdown to Over Drive pre-show and one taped as a digital exclusive.

zh.s: 《Over Drive》是Impact Wrestling举办的一场职业摔角赛事，于2022年11月18日在肯塔基州路易斯维尔的Old Forester Paristown Hall举行，并通过Impact Plus和YouTube播出。合作推广方墨西哥AAA全球摔角和新日本职业摔角的选手也参加了赛事。比赛共设10场，其中两场在《Over Drive》预热节目中举行，另有一场录制为网络独家内容。

en.s: Bellator 288: Nemkov vs. Anderson 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA that took place on November 18, 2022, at the Wintrust Arena in Chicago, Illinois, United States.

zh.s: “Bellator 288：涅姆科夫对安德森二番战”是Bellator MMA举办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2022年11月18日在美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥的Wintrust体育馆举行。

en.s: The 2023 Louisiana Attorney General election was held on November 18, 2023, to elect the next attorney general of Louisiana, with the first round occurring on October 14. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Jeff Landry retired to successfully run for governor, leading to an open race. In the runoff, Louisiana Solicitor General Liz Murrill defeated attorney Lindsey Cheek by a margin of 33 percent.

zh.t: 2023年路易斯安那州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2023年路易斯安那州总检察长选举于11月18日举行，选出下一任总检察长，第一轮投票在10月14日举行。时任共和党总检察长杰夫·兰德里辞职竞选州长，因此该职位成为空缺。第二轮投票中，路易斯安那州总检察长办公室法律总顾问莉兹·默里尔以33个百分点的优势击败律师林赛·奇克。

en.s: Fightland (2023) was a professional wrestling event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW). It took place on November 18, 2023, at the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and was the fifth event under the Fightland chronology. The event streamed live on FITE, with additional matches taped for future episodes of MLW Fusion.

zh.s: 《Fightland》（2023）是美国职业摔角联盟（MLW）举办的一场职业摔角赛事，于2023年11月18日在宾夕法尼亚州费城的2300竞技场举行，是该系列第5场赛事。赛事通过FITE直播，另有比赛录制下来，供日后播出的《MLW Fusion》使用。

en.s: The 2023 Full Gear was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW). It was the fifth annual Full Gear and took place on November 18, 2023, at the Kia Forum in the Los Angeles suburb of Inglewood, California. Eleven matches were contested at the event, including three on the "Zero Hour" pre-show. In the main event, MJF defeated Jay White to retain the AEW World Championship.

zh.s: 《Full Gear》（2023）是精英摔角（AEW）举办的职业摔角付费收看赛事，也是该系列第5届赛事，于2023年11月18日在加利福尼亚州英格尔伍德的Kia论坛举行。赛事共设11场比赛，其中3场在“Zero Hour”预热节目中举行。主赛中，MJF击败杰伊·怀特，卫冕AEW世界冠军。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Craig
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Craig (also known as UFC Fight Night 232, UFC on ESPN+ 90 and UFC Vegas 82) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on November 18, 2023, at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：艾伦对克雷格
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：艾伦对克雷格也称UFC格斗之夜232、UFC on ESPN+ 90和UFC维加斯82，是终极格斗冠军赛举办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2023年11月18日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行，该地属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The 2023 Mulgrave state by-election was held on 18 November 2023 to elect the next member for Mulgrave in the Victorian Legislative Assembly, following the resignation of Victorian premier and incumbent MP Daniel Andrews.

zh.s: 2023年马尔格雷夫选区补选于11月18日举行，为维多利亚州立法议会的马尔格雷夫选区选出新议员。此次补选是在维多利亚州州长兼时任议员丹尼尔·安德鲁斯辞职后举行的。

en.s: France v Gibraltar was a football match belonging to the UEFA Euro 2024 qualifying that took place on 18 November 2023. France's 14–0 victory became the largest in their history, as well as the largest in the history of the European Championship qualifiers.

zh.t: 法国对阵直布罗陀（2024年欧洲杯预选赛）
zh.s: 法国队与直布罗陀队于2023年11月18日进行了一场2024年欧洲杯预选赛。法国队以14比0获胜，创下该队史上最大比分胜利，也是欧洲杯预选赛历史上的最大比分胜利。

en.s: The 2023 Louisiana House of Representatives election was held on October 14, 2023, with runoff elections held on November 18, 2023. All 105 seats in the Louisiana House of Representatives were up for election to four-year terms. It was held concurrently with elections for all statewide offices and the Louisiana State Senate.

All 39 seats in the Louisiana State Senate were up for election to four-year terms. It was held concurrently with elections for all statewide offices and the Louisiana House of Representatives. Under Louisiana's jungle primary system, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party, and voters may vote for any candidate, regardless of their party affiliation.

en.s: The 2024 Umbrian regional election took place on 17 and 18 November 2024. The centre-left candidate, mayor of Assisi Stefania Proietti, defeated incumbent centre-right president Donatella Tesei, who ran for re-election, by 5 points.

zh.s: 翁布里亚大区选举于2024年11月17日至18日举行。中左翼候选人、阿西西市长斯特凡妮娅·普罗耶蒂以5个百分点的优势击败寻求连任的中右翼现任主席多纳泰拉·泰塞伊。

en.s: The 2024 Emilia-Romagna regional election took place in Emilia-Romagna, Italy, on 17–18 November 2024. The elections were called following Stefano Bonaccini's election to the European Parliament, a position incompatible with his post as the regional president. He resigned on 12 July 2024, on the same day, the Democratic Party unanimously nominated Mayor of Ravenna Michele De Pascale as its candidate.

zh.t: 2024年艾米利亚-罗马涅大区选举
zh.s: 意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅大区于2024年11月17日至18日举行选举。此次选举是在斯特凡诺·博纳奇尼当选欧洲议会议员后举行的，因为欧洲议会议员职位与大区主席职位不相容。博纳奇尼于2024年7月12日辞职。同日，民主党一致提名拉文纳市长米凯莱·德帕斯卡莱为候选人。

en.s: The 2025 Allerød Municipal election was held on November 18, 2025, in the Danish municipality of Allerød to elect the 21 members to sit in the regional council for the Allerød Municipal council, in the period of 2026 to 2029. Clara Rao from Venstre, would win the mayoral position.

zh.s: 丹麦阿勒勒市于2025年11月18日举行市政选举，选出21名成员，组成任期为2026年至2029年的阿勒勒市议会。来自自由党（Venstre）的克拉拉·饶将出任市长。

en.s: The 2025 Kalundborg Municipal election was held on November 18, 2025, to elect the 27 members to sit in the regional council for the Kalundborg Municipal council, in the Danish city of Kalundborg, in the period of 2026 to 2029. Martin Damm from Venstre, would secure re-election.

zh.s: 丹麦卡伦堡市于2025年11月18日举行市政选举，选出27名成员，组成任期为2026年至2029年的卡伦堡市议会。来自自由党（Venstre）的马丁·达姆将连任市长。

en.s: The 2025 Thisted Municipal election was held on November 18, 2025, to elect the 27 members to sit in the regional council for the Thisted Municipal council, in the period of 2026 to 2029.
